pr_title: fix(rust, python): fix `is_in` on empty series

issue_context.title: Panic with invalid `is_in`
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.


### Reproducible example

```python
pl.Series([1]).is_in(pl.Series([[]]))
# => PanicException: called `Result::unwrap()` on an `Err` value: SchemaMismatch(ErrString("cannot unpack series, data types don't match"))
```


### Issue description

See example 

### Expected behavior

Better error message or boolean result.
